stem: A resident pharmacy has closed. Select all post-closure duties supported by the rule.

choices.text: Submit original licenses and the controlled-substance registration within 14 days.
Keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed location.
Attest to lawful controlled-substance disposal or transfer.
Wait one year before notifying the Board.
Treat Form 222 records as patient property.
